method: Native RGB pixels. A static row band is used only while the active block is settled. Bright means all channels >=210 and channel range <38; >=3 bright pixels must occur in a column. Normalization uses observed horizontal ink extent. These are effective visible fronts, not native span timing or alpha. Whitespace, antialiasing, source encoding and chosen threshold create uncertainty. Values plateau across word spacing and are not smooth animation keyframes. Motion interval17.45-18.25 is excluded.
